description: This morning's digest run failed (enrich lane error) and nothing was sent. The daily security email not going out is exactly what the beat exists to catch: escalate once, with the command to rerun it.
seen_in: design: SKILL.md step 3, a failed lane is escalated with the exact operator command
board_extra: run-digest daily failed: enrich lane failed

journal.cti-agent-digest.service:
{{journal:-240m}} fleetbox run-digest[4211]: [run-digest] start
{{journal:-237m}} fleetbox run-digest[4211]: [enrich] NVD: request failed 503 Service Unavailable (3 retries)
{{journal:-236m}} fleetbox run-digest[4211]: [run-digest] FAILED: enrich lane failed
{{journal:-236m}} fleetbox systemd[1]: cti-agent-digest.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE

must.why: the daily email did not go out; the operator is told once
the beat never runs a lane itself; it tells the operator the command
the verdict names the lane that failed

should.why: the alert carries the exact command to rerun it
